name: Repashy Soilent Green
description: Gel-premix algae/aufwuchs grazing diet, set into a sinking gel block (modelled here as a wafer-form substrate food). Manufacturer guaranteed-analysis crude protein minimum is 30%. wasteFactor (0.32) is MODELLED — gel holds together well while grazed but a sizeable uneaten block fouls fast, so the high end of the wafer band.
notes: Grazing diet for shrimp + herbivorous bottom feeders. Prepared from powder; the gel block is treated as a wafer-form substrate food by the husbandry sim.
